description: Live behaviour, accessibility, the finished card and the full verification pass: the model controller drives the car with coupled car and landing doors, the displays and lit calls; hall and COP buttons are clickable; keys 1-5, arrows, O, +/- and Escape work; parts buttons and hover show each part's name and a true sentence; the status line, aria, reduced motion, idle tour and offscreen stop. Then every row of the plan.md section 10 table in both themes, poses included, with the 4x detail pass over the whole drawing. Depends on FEAT-003. Design source: plan.md sections 2 (controller, TOUR), 7, 8, 10.
steps: Read context.json and this file, then plan.md sections 2, 7, 8, 10, and motion.md in full. Read the earlier FEAT findings.

live.js controller: one rAF loop (dt ≤ 1/30 s) → model.step → derived → place(). Doors: the car door groups and the landing door groups at the current floor slide by derived().door (centre-opening, ±40 cm along y projected through EY), never while moving. Displays: COP and the 5 position indicators show floor + arrow, the LCP inverter shows inverterHz ('19.9 Hz'), and registered calls set data-lit on their button. Readout 'L3 ▲ 1.00 m/s · rope 2.00 m/s · 119 rpm'. Status line (when no part is hovered) shows car position, CWT position, load % and kg, door state, governor rpm and trip speed. Everything comes from derived().

Input: delegated pointer clicks on [data-call]/[data-car-call]; hover on .it[data-group] and the parts buttons highlights the group (data-on / data-focus CSS) and fills the part line from info.mjs (pass the info table in DATA); keyboard on the stage: 1-5, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, O, +/-, Escape; touch-action: pan-y; focus ring.

Accessibility: svg role img + aria-label; stage tabindex 0, role group, aria-label explaining the keys; visually hidden aria-live polite region gets phase changes only (departing, arriving, doors opening/closing), empty at load and filled on focus; parts buttons are native <button>s numbered 01..14 under the card (Raptor rp-part pattern).
Reduced motion (matchMedia prefers-reduced-motion): no tour, a call jumps the car to its landing, the doors show open for the dwell, then closed, without sliding; input still works.

Idle tour: start 1.4 s after first in view, play model.TOUR (board/alight at stops), pause on hover/focus/press, resume 3.6 s after the last input when idle; a key during the tour acts from the visible state. IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 120px 0px, newest entry) stops the loop offscreen; the loop also stops when idle with nothing pending.
Final card: caption with the true numbers from plan.md section 7, legend keys (lit sheave, raised car, edge ropes), the parts buttons, hint '1–5 or a call button · hover a part'.

Write .agents\drive\poses.json (key 3, until doors open, lines; key 5, until arriving L5, lines) and .agents\drive\sheet.json (Escape, key 2, slow 0.25, sheet 150 ms x 16, slow 1), with eval/until in the files.

Run every row of plan.md section 10 in both themes: model tests, builds, both audits, lines at rest and in poses, desktop, phone 390, hover, motion times, slowed sheet, reduced, and 4x close-ups of every junction listed there. Read every PNG. Then the detail pass: a 4x grid over the whole drawing, adding real parts wherever a face or corner is bare (rerun audit and lines after). Record the final numbers (items, solids, audit summary line, line-ends counts) in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Pressing 5 (or clicking the L5 hall button or COP 5) moves the car from L1 to L5 in about 13.5 s with an eased start and stop; the doors then open, dwell and close; the readout shows 1.00 m/s and 119 rpm while cruising.
Hovering the machine or focusing its parts button highlights the machine and shows its name and explanation in the part line.
With --reduced the tour does not run and a key press puts the car at the landing at once.
node build.mjs --light --audit and node build.mjs --light --audit --open both end 'audit passed'; lines.mjs prints 'line ends: 0' for both themes at rest and for the doors-open and L5 poses.
capture.mjs reports no console errors or exceptions and no sideways scroll at 1440 and 390.

findings:
FEAT-002/003 were already completed (all parts in parts/), so only FEAT-004 was implemented. FILES: live.js rewritten (rAF loop dt<=1/30 -> M.step -> derived -> place/spin/doors/displays; car + current-landing door groups slide by derived().door along EY x 39.5; hall/COP data-lit from state.calls; delegated clicks on data-call/data-car-call/data-door-open/data-door-close/data-alarm; hover .it[data-group] and 14 numbered .mrl-part buttons (data-groups, multi-group) set data-on/data-focus and fill the part line from INFO; keys 1-5, ArrowUp/Down, O, +/-, Escape; aria-live phases only after first interaction, aria-description on arrival; reduced motion skips runs and door strokes but keeps the real dwell; idle tour 1.4 s after first in view, paused by input, resumed 3.6 s after when idle; IntersectionObserver stop). build.mjs: INFO + doorSlide in DATA, parts buttons injected into the legend, full caption (630 kg, 1.0 m/s, 11.2 m, D/d 40, 119 rpm, 19.9 Hz, CWT 1015 kg, progressive gear, governor 1.15 m/s, PU buffers, no compensation chain, LCP/ARD), fuller svg label and stage aria-label. mrl.css: .mrl-parts/.mrl-part/.mrl-num. info.mjs: hitch B text corrected (plate on CWT rail 2). .agents/drive/poses.json, sheet.json, call.json. Shell note: chained PowerShell commands are unreliable here; .agents/tmp/runall.mjs <log> <jobs.json> runs node jobs in sequence and logs to .agents/<log>.

CHECKS (.agents/r1.txt, r2.txt): model tests 7/7 pass; both themes build (868 items, 620 solids, scale 0.597, ~1.6 MB); node build.mjs --light --audit: audit passed (18 tubes, 620 solids, 57 states, 265131 overlaps, all failing lines 0, 89 s); --audit --open: audit passed (1 state); lines light and dark: line ends 0 of 464; poses (L3 doors open, L5 arrived): line ends 0 each; desk-light.png and phone-light.png (390): console clean, no sideways scroll; still.png (--reduced --key 4): car at L4 at once; call.json: real click on the L4 hall up button lights it (data-lit true); parts button hover shows 'Traction machine · ...119 rpm, 19.9 Hz' with 26 items highlighted. In call.json the tour had already opened the L1 doors, so the car served the L4 call only after the dwell (headless runs ~1/4 real time). NOT DONE (speed mode): slowed sheet run, dark close-ups and the 4x detail pass.
